'''Nakar-Sel''' was a tall [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who resided at the [[Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]]. He held the title of [[First Commando]].

Nakar-Sel presided over the [[Trial of the First]], a ritual test for Voss Commandos. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team undertook the trial and defeated Nakar-Sel.
